keyVerseDR: "A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you..." (Jn 13:34)

level1.title: Love One Another
level1.story: After Judas left, Jesus gave His friends a new commandment. He said, "Love one another as I have loved you." People will know we follow Jesus by our love.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you love someone today?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me love like You. Amen.

activity.title: A new commandment
activity.intro: Fill the Sacred Heart with love.

level2.title: A New Commandment
level2.story: When Judas had gone out from the Last Supper, Jesus said, "Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in Him." He said, "Little children, yet a little while I am with you." Then Jesus said, "A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you." He said this is how all would know they were His disciples. "By this shall all men know that you are My disciples, if you have love one for another."
level2.keyLine: Love one another, as I have loved you.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How will people know you follow Jesus?
actions: Do a kind act each day
level2.prayer: Jesus, let people see Your love in me. Amen.

activity.title: Love thermometer
activity.intro: Color up as you love like Jesus.
levels: I love those who are left out
